caveats: ⚑ burst weaponSwap.durationSec = 10 is UNMEASURED. The kit text states no duration for the weapon change; 10s is the standard Full Burst window assumed as the swap's bound. If the swap is instead uses-bound (ends after its single shot) or ends at Full Burst end regardless, the shot economy changes materially.

⚑ burst weapon-swap SHOT ECONOMY is kit-silent and unmodeled beyond the time bound: maxAmmo 1 forces a reload after every swapped shot, so shots fired = f(2s charge time, SR reload, swap start phase). No maxShots is set (the kit gives no uses limit); the engine's cadence + reload model decides the count. Estimate ~2 full-charge shots in a 10s window (2s charge + ~2.35s reload from reloadFrames 141).
⚑ Cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / rate-of-fire) is datamine-sourced and known-unreliable; the burst swap overrides charge time to 2s but inherits the base reload cadence.

Pierce is scoped to the SWAPPED weapon only (weaponSwap.hasPierce), NOT the unit-level hasPierce flag — the 'Additional Effect: Pierce' line sits inside the burst's weapon-change block, so her base SR shots are not Pierce-tagged.

skill1 target is authored WITHOUT excludeSelf: 'Affects 2 allies with the highest final ATK' is read as a self-inclusive candidate pool (no 'except the skill user' clause). If self is excluded in game, maxwell loses her own 43.1% ATK / 4.48% Charge Speed and her burst damage drops materially — this is the single highest-leverage open question in this baseline.
byFinalAtk:true is set because the kit says 'highest FINAL ATK' literally (live buffed ranking), not plain 'highest ATK'.

skill2 is entirely INERT in solo-raid scope: its gate is '>5 enemy units, excluding Nikkes' and the scope-lock boss is a single partless enemy. The schema has no enemy-count gate, so the block is omitted rather than modeled as a passive — modeling it passively would silently grant permanent +4.83% Crit Rate / +13.91% Crit Damage that the fight never earns.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Maxwell (SR/Iron/Attacker/Burst III) is modeled as: S1 = a team buff on Full Burst entry (charge speed + ATK, 10s, to the 2 highest-final-ATK allies, self-inclusive); S2 = inert in this scope (>5-enemy gate, unsatisfiable vs a single boss — see unmodeled); burst = a self weapon swap to a 2s-charge, 1-round, Pierce-tagged cannon at 813.42% with a 300% full-charge multiplier. The swap's duration and shot economy are kit-silent and flagged.

audit.kitLine: Affects self. Change the weapon in use:
audit.effectOrReason: trigger {kind:'burstCast'} + target self + effect kind 'weaponSwap' — a self mode in the unit's OWN burst block is burst-cast keyed (fires only on rotations SHE bursts), never fullBurstEnter
weaponSwap.chargeTimeSec = 2 (overrides the base chargeFrames 60 = 1s; the swap weapon charges SLOWER, which is why the S1 charge-speed line matters)
weaponSwap.chargeMultPct = 300 — multiplier ON the 813.42% per-shot damage for a full-charge release (not an additive 300%)
weaponSwap.maxAmmo = 1 — weapon-state modifier, IS damage: forces a reload after every swapped shot, which is the binding constraint on swap shot count
weaponSwap.hasPierce = true (swap-scoped Pierce tag), NOT the top-level hasPierce flag — the line is inside the weapon-change block, so only swapped shots are Pierce-tagged
⚑ weaponSwap.durationSec = 10 assumed (standard Full Burst window). Required field with no kit source — flagged, not silently shipped.

flags.reasoning: The kit text gives the weapon swap NO duration at all — it lists only charge time, damage, ammo and pierce. durationSec is a required field on weaponSwap, so a value must be invented. 10s is the standard Full Burst window and the default assumption for a Burst III self weapon-change with no stated bound. This is outside the input domain: it could equally be a uses-bound swap (one shot), a longer window, or a swap that persists until reload.
flags.recipe: Record one fight with maxwell bursting. From the video, timestamp the burst banner and the LAST shot fired with the swapped-weapon visual/popup value (a swapped full-charge hit is ~813.42%×3 of final ATK and Pierce-tagged, so it is unmistakable against her base SR normals at 69.04%). Swap duration = last-swapped-shot frame − banner frame, rounded to the nearest whole second. Cross-check against the Full Burst end marker: if the last swapped shot lands exactly at FB end, the swap is FB-window-bound (10s); if it ends earlier at a fixed offset regardless of FB, it has its own timer; if exactly one swapped shot ever fires, re-author as maxShots:1.

flags.estimate: ~2 full-charge swapped shots per burst; no maxShots set, no pullsPerSec override
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ field: weapon-swap shot economy is kit-silent. maxAmmo 1 means every swapped shot is followed by a full reload, so the cycle is (2s charge + reload). With the datamined reloadFrames 141 (~2.35s) the cycle is ~4.35s, giving ~2 full-charge shots inside a 10s window — and that count is highly sensitive to (a) the S1 charge-speed buff if she is in her own top-2 ATK pool, (b) whether the swap starts with a loaded round, (c) whether reload speed applies to the swap weapon. Estimated optimistically at 2 rather than 1 per the swap-economy prior; a partial third is possible with charge-speed help.
flags.recipe: Count swapped-weapon damage popups per burst directly from footage (they are the Pierce-tagged ~813%×3 hits, orders of magnitude above her 69.04% normals). Do this across ≥3 bursts in one fight and ≥2 fights, and separately for a comp where she IS in the top-2 final-ATK pool vs one where she is not, to isolate the charge-speed contribution. If the observed count is invariant at N regardless of buffs, the swap is uses-bound → set maxShots:N and stop trusting the time bound.

flags.reasoning: 'Affects 2 allies with the highest final ATK' carries no 'except the skill user' clause, and the schema's excludeSelf is documented as the encoding for kits that DO carry that clause — so the literal-word rule says self is in the candidate pool. But maxwell is an Attacker (class static ATK 118,027 at scope-lock Base 5, the highest of the three classes), so she will almost always BE in her own top 2, making this the difference between her burst landing with +43.1% ATK and a 4.48% faster 2s charge, or with neither. High leverage, decided on wording alone.
flags.recipe: Run the comp twice in-sim with excludeSelf absent vs true and diff her total damage to size the effect first. To resolve empirically: record a fight and read her damage popup values across a Full Burst boundary — an ATK buff landing on her shows as a step change in her normal-attack popup magnitude at FB entry (≈+43.1% on the base 69.04% hits, well outside popup read noise). If her own popups do NOT step at FB entry while a teammate's do, excludeSelf is true.

flags.reasoning: Set on the literal word 'final' in 'the highest final ATK' — the schema states byFinalAtk is used ONLY when the kit literally says final, otherwise static ranking. Flagged because live-buffed ranking is order-dependent: on a team where another unit's buffs land first, the top-2 set can differ from the static-ATK set, and this changes WHO gets the 43.1%.
flags.recipe: No new recording needed — this is settled by the kit wording under the existing literal-word convention. If a discrepancy ever appears, compare per-unit damage in a comp where static and final ATK ranking disagree (e.g. a pre-buffed Supporter overtaking an Attacker) and see which unit's popups step at FB entry.

flags.field: cadence tuple (base SR: chargeFrames 60, reloadFrames 141, hitsPerShot 1)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑: rate_of_fire / reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and for this unit they are load-bearing twice over — reload dominates the burst-swap shot count (maxAmmo 1 = reload every shot) and charge time gates her base-weapon uptime. A nominal rate that does not fall on a 60fps frame boundary rounds up in practice.
flags.recipe: Read her ammo counter and charge indicator frame-by-frame from footage outside Full Burst: reload duration = frames from empty to refilled; charge time = frames from trigger-hold to the full-charge visual. Compare against 141f / 60f. Use the ammo counter (which measures the disputed quantity directly), not downstream damage totals.
